objectives.summary: The project aims to develop CloudScript, an online app development studio designed for both beginners and experts. It seeks to provide a user-friendly platform for creating applications and websites without extensive coding knowledge, targeting small and medium-sized businesses. The project is currently 104% funded, with funding allocated for marketing, hiring, and further development.
key_points: CloudScript is designed to be easy to use for beginners while offering powerful features for experts.
The project has a funding goal that was not reached by February 20, 2018, but is currently 104% funded.
Funding will be utilized for marketing, hiring staff, and advancing the project to the next level.
CloudScript allows users to create apps for Android, iOS, and Windows without writing code or by using JavaScript.
The platform combines high-end development capabilities with user-friendly features, making it suitable for small and medium-sized businesses.
The funding period for the project was from December 22, 2017, to February 20, 2018.
